translation_notes: identity translation: the region is plumbing (click options, logging, Graph(), parse, apply_patch, serialize) and contains no RDF term or triple written literally in the source, so no island applies; translated.ldpy is byte-identical to original.py

the KGCL commands and the SPARQL UPDATE they become are opaque Python strings built inside kgcl_rdflib.apply, outside the region -- ldpy islands do not reach inside string literals, and this is the right answer here

context shims (identical for both sides, resolved by import path so no import line changed): local packages kgcl_schema/grammar/parser.py and kgcl_rdflib/apply/graph_transformer.py. graph_transformer.apply_patch and its rename->SPARQL UPDATE are reproduced from INCATools/kgcl-rdflib@7af638bbd7 (kgcl_2_sparql.rename, IRI-subject / no-language branch); the kgcl_schema lark parser is not installable, so parser.parse is a stub covering the single 'rename <IRI> from 'x' to 'y'' command the harness uses

demo harness added identically to both sides: cli is a click Command and cannot be called through run_pair(entry=...) with ordinary arguments, so a trailing section invokes cli.main([...], standalone_mode=False) on the local input.ttl, writes patched.ttl and parses it back into DEMO_GRAPH (the rename is really applied: ex:x rdfs:label "old" -> "new")
input.ttl and patched.ttl are fixtures created for the harness, not part of the source repository
